note: Low-confidence analyst-drawn approximate search areas following the archived actual street/rail/waterway fabric. Printed/legal street loops are supporting context where cited, not a claim that every vertex exactly follows a statutory line. Ends, estate transitions and internal divisions are inferred. Existing native districts and quarters remain independent parent context; no radius or Voronoi construction.

areas.name: Újpest Kertváros
areas.anchors: Municipal street loop Fóti út – XV district/rail boundary – Görgey Artúr utca – Deák Ferenc utca – Attila utca. The ring is a coarse trace of this loop against the actual road context; not legal precision.

areas.name: Újpest Északi Kertváros
areas.anchors: Municipal street loop Szilas-patak – Szilágyi utca/XV district rail boundary – Fóti út – Baross utca. Coarse trace of the mapped loop, including the creek-facing residential fabric.

areas.name: Újpest Városközpont
areas.anchors: Coarse municipal loop trace: Váci/József Attila/Attila/Deák Ferenc/István/Király/Kassai/Munkásotthon/Aradi/Berda József/Mártírok streets and the southern railway. Smaller bends in the legal loop are generalized.

areas.name: Izzó lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact housing fabric around Izzó, Szekér and Vadgesztenye streets south of the Szilas creek, east of the Baross/Fóti street belt; institutional edges and the northwest termination are inferred.

areas.name: Szilaspatak-lakópark
areas.anchors: Small mapped residential blocks on the Damjanich/Szőnyi/Ráday street belt near the Szilas creek and railway; actual local access streets define the approximate estate envelope.

areas.name: Károlyi Városnegyed
areas.anchors: Mapped redevelopment blocks between Váci út and Megyeri út around Tinódi, Irányi and Zsilip streets. Northern/southern internal block edges are inferred from street fabric, not the whole Újpest parent.

areas.name: Óbuda-lakókert
areas.anchors: Small Bóbita/Csengőbojt/Panyóka/Léva street development beside the Bécsi-road and railway corridor; envelope follows the visible local estate street pattern.

areas.name: Gyógyszergyár utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Small housing cluster around Bojtár/Orbán Balázs/Gyógyszergyár streets east of Bécsi út. The surrounding industrial blocks are excluded; uncertain internal estate margins are inferred.

areas.name: Lajos utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Visible apartment-block fabric along Lajos/Pacsirtamező/Perc streets and the Árpád bridge approach. Compact estate trace rather than the whole Óbuda parent.

areas.name: Rózsavölgy
areas.anchors: Elongated residential valley following Hosszúréti-patak/Ady Endre út, bounded approximately by the Péterhegyi/Rózsavölgyi and Gerinc/Honfoglalás hillside street belts. Broader traditional area; not a Kis/Nagy parent union or a legal quarter boundary.

areas.name: Rózsakert utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Apartment blocks around Rózsakert/Szent László/Mátyás király streets north of the Nagytétényi corridor; estate transition along mapped access streets is approximate.

areas.name: Mézesfehér utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Apartment fabric east of the Mézesfehér street belt, north of Tordai/Attila streets and toward the Budafoki road/railway corridor. Small estate boundary is inferred from actual streets.

areas.name: József Attila utcai (kísérleti) lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact experimental housing strip around József Attila/Káldor Adolf/Terv streets north of the railway; generalized estate edges follow visible street blocks.

areas.name: Ómátyásföld
areas.anchors: The existing native Mátyásföld parent polygon is divided approximately along the actual Veres Péter/HÉV corridor. The southern villa-settlement component containing the old-place point is retained; the cut is manually generalized and not a reconstructed historical/legal boundary.

areas.name: Újmátyásföld
areas.anchors: The existing native Mátyásföld parent polygon is divided approximately along the Veres Péter/HÉV corridor. The northern component containing the new-place point is retained. Municipal heritage inventory anchors a new-settlement block at Veres Péter/Blaha Lujza/István király/Cél tábla streets; outer parent extent is preserved.

areas.name: Centenárium lakótelep
areas.anchors: Coarse trace of the documented Olga/Margit/Rovás/Sasvár/Lőcs/Budapesti street loop against actual mapped streets; minor junction bends generalized.

areas.name: Jókai-lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact postwar blocks around Csenkesz/Jókai/Kolozs/Mészáros József streets south of Veres Péter út. Estate edges are inferred from the visible blocks, not the entire Ómátyásföld parent.

areas.name: Petőfikert
areas.anchors: Generalized trace of the documented Nógrádverőce/Zsemlékes/Íjász/Zselic/Léva/Újszász street loop. Uncertain street turns are inferred from the current grid; overlaps with the broader Mátyásföld quarter are intentional.

areas.name: Gazdagréti lakótelep
areas.anchors: Mapped apartment estate between the Rétköz street curve and Gazdagréti út, toward Nagyszeben/Budaörsi roads. This is a smaller estate envelope inside the broader native Gazdagrét area, following the documented estate street loop approximately.

areas.name: Madárhegyi lakópark
areas.anchors: Compact development street fabric around Talpas/Hosszúréti/Madárhegyi residential blocks; the broader Madárhegy hillside parent is not reused as the estate.

areas.name: Csepel-Alsó Királyerdő
areas.anchors: Southern search subdivision of the existing native Csepel-Királyerdő polygon. A manually generalized cross-street cut follows the Vadrózsa/Repkeny/Tulipán street belt; the actual parent outer boundary is preserved. No municipal/legal separate Alsó boundary is claimed.

areas.name: Gloriett-lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact apartment estate around Csáth Géza/Sina Simon/Visnyovszky Lajos streets between the Szabadka and Közdűlő/Margó Tivadar street belts. The broad Gloriett-telep parent is not substituted for this smaller estate.

areas.name: Szentlőrinc úti lakótelep
areas.anchors: Small XX-district residential estate around Köves/Szentlőrinci/Újtelep street access and the mapped apartment-block fabric. This is not the distinct XVIII-district Szent Lőrinc-lakótelep; no BP18 boundary is reused.

areas.name: Kispest-Kertváros
areas.anchors: Residential grid west of the Gloriett/Szabadság street belt, bounded approximately by the Nagykőrösi railway/road corridor and Puskás Ferenc/Temesvár street fabric. Boundary is an inferred garden-city search convention, not a legal quarter perimeter.

areas.name: Országbíró utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Apartment-block ensemble on both sides of Országbíró promenade around Röppentyű/Béke/Petneházy/Szegedi street context. The extent is a generalized estate envelope, not an entire Angyalföld parent.

areas.name: Szilas lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact estate at Szilas park/Tóth István/Rézöntő/Nyírpalota streets, adjoining the Szilas creek. Mapped local estate access streets support the envelope; the park transition is inferred.

areas.name: Újpalotai lakótelep
areas.anchors: The mapped Újpalota apartment ensemble around Nyírpalota/Erdőkerülő/Szentmihályi/Zsókavár street fabric. A compact high-rise estate envelope is inferred inside the broader native Újpalota parent; outer garden/industrial territory is excluded.
areas.sizeOverrideJustification: Újpalota is one of the capital’s genuinely large continuous estates, so the generic0.75km² safeguard would truncate its housing fabric. A1km² ceiling is used only here, and the traced estate envelope is intersected with the existing native Újpalota polygon; the3.62km² full parent is not reused.

areas.name: Egressy téri lakótelep
areas.anchors: Apartment estate blocks around Egressy tér/Kövér Lajos/Angol/Róna street fabric, between Egressy and Mogyoródi road belts. The compact courtyard and access-street perimeter is inferred.

areas.name: Mogyoródi–Jerney úti lakótelep
areas.anchors: Apartment rows around the Mogyoródi/Jerney/Lengyel street belt southeast of the Egressy-road corridor. Boundary follows local mapped block edges approximately.

areas.name: Nagy Lajos király úti lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact high-rise blocks around Nagy Lajos király útja/Kalapács/Bánki Donát/Álmos vezér street fabric; the neighboring broad Nagyzugló quarter is not reused.

areas.name: Paskál lakópark
areas.anchors: Mapped housing blocks by Bosnyák/Termál/Paskálmalom/Rósa Lajos streets south of the Rákos creek. Adjacent separately named Paskál Garden/Rose developments remain independently searchable.

areas.name: Pálya utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Estate blocks around Pálya/Rigó/Vezseny/Rákospalotai határút street context. Small local streets support the envelope; external garden plots are excluded approximately.

areas.name: Szent Korona-lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact mapped housing cluster around Szatmári/Szent Korona/Polgár/Pálya streets north of Budapesti út. Internal courtyard edges are inferred rather than treating all Sashalom as an estate.

areas.name: Egyenes utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Apartment-block fabric by Egyenes/Zalatna/Gépmadár streets just north of the Kerepesi corridor. The neighborhood-envelope ends follow mapped local access streets approximately.

areas.name: Örs vezér téri lakótelep
areas.anchors: Mapped apartment fabric around Ond vezér/Kántorné/Táltos/Álmos vezér street context adjoining the Örs transport center. The commercial/rail interchange is excluded approximately.

areas.name: Zenit Corso
areas.anchors: Small redevelopment block by Nagy Lajos király útja/Csömöri/Bosnyák street context. The inferred estate outline covers the local block rather than using the broader Zugló parent area.

areas.name: Lándzsa utcai lakótelep
areas.anchors: Compact apartment cluster around Lándzsa/Gárdonyi Géza/Holdfény street blocks south of the Veres Péter corridor; local estate streets and block fabric provide approximate bounds.
